name: Arcane Ruin
body:
You can easily break magical items.

Prerequisite: Boggle, 6th level.

Benefit: Any successful hit that you score against a magic item that causes damage to that item also causes that item to obtain the broken condition. The item must be restored to its original hit points before it may lose this condition.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
